text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly overnight while the broader market, led by altcoins like BNB and SOL, shows deeper weakness—suggesting selective risk-off behavior rather than capitulation. Fear & Greed sits firmly in greed territory with an upward bias over the week, indicating sentiment remains constructive despite the price dips. Bitcoin's dominance holding above 58% alongside $95B in 24-hour volume signals neither panic liquidation nor euphoric breakout, but rather a consolidation phase where investors are rotating cautiously.
